'''2000 Birmingham Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner was to receive a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]<ref name="gs00cal" /><ref name="dt-11431" /><ref name="dt-11438" />
* '''Date:''' 7–8 October 2000 on Decipher's calendar;<ref name="gs00cal" /> Andy McClure's post of 29 October 2000 says he won it "yesterday" (28 October)<ref name="dt-11431" />
* '''Site:''' Birmingham, Alabama
* '''Players:''' 26<ref name="tr-d1405" />

== Discrepancies ==

Where sources disagree, this page keeps the best-supported record and notes the difference here.

* Decipher's Grand Slam calendar dates the event 7–8 October 2000; Andy McClure's DeckTech post of 29 October 2000 says he won it 'yesterday' (28 October 2000), and his decks contain Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck cards released 25 October 2000.<ref name="gs00cal" />
